one_line: Elusive master storyteller of the lost Great Tale remembered in Satavahana and later Kashmiri tradition.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean and wiry, with the light muscle tone of someone used to long walks and writing outdoors
appearance.face: oval face with a straight nose, warm medium-brown Deccan complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, intense narrow eyes with dark circles from long nights of writing, default expression a focused, inward-looking calm with a hint of melancholy.
appearance.hair: thick black hair gathered into a modest topknot at the back of the crown, sides smoothed back, with a simple narrow white cotton headband tied around the forehead, knot at the back.
appearance.costume: He wears a long off-white cotton uttariya (shawl) with a faint beige border draped from the left shoulder across the torso and wrapped around the back, over a knee-length, short-sleeved, pale-ochre cotton tunic (kurta-like) belted with a plain dark-brown leather girdle; below, he has straight, ankle-length off-white cotton trousers slightly tapered at the ankles, and simple dark-brown leather sandals; a small dark-red cloth pouch hangs from his belt, and a narrow beaded wooden mala is worn around his neck; the textiles are simple, slightly creased, with minimal pattern beyond subtle woven borders on the shawl.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved palm-leaf manuscript bundle bound with a thin red cord, stained at the edges, which he cradles in one arm along with a slim stylus held between fingers.

ref_desc: Guṇāḍhya is a mid-30s lean medium-brown man with an oval face, short beard, black hair in a topknot with a white headband, wearing an off-white shawl over a pale-ochre tunic, off-white trousers, dark-brown sandals, beaded mala, and carrying a red-bound palm-leaf manuscript and stylus in off-white, pale ochre, dark brown, dark red, and black tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Guṇāḍhya: a mid-30s lean, wiry man of medium-brown Deccan complexion with an oval face, straight nose, intense narrow eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, his expression focused and inward-looking with a hint of melancholy. His thick black hair is gathered into a modest topknot at the back of the crown, with the sides smoothed back and a simple narrow white cotton headband tied around his forehead, knot at the back. He wears a long off-white cotton shawl with a faint beige border draped from his left shoulder across the torso and around the back, over a knee-length, short-sleeved pale-ochre cotton tunic belted at the waist with a plain dark-brown leather girdle. Show straight, ankle-length off-white cotton trousers slightly tapered at the ankles and simple dark-brown leather sandals on his feet. Add a small dark-red cloth pouch hanging from his belt and a narrow wooden bead mala around his neck. His signature prop is a long slightly curved palm-leaf manuscript bundle with edges darkened, bound with a thin red cord, cradled in one arm while he holds a slim stylus between his fingers in the other hand. Use a restrained palette of off-white, pale ochre, dark brown, dark red, and black, and present him front, side and back to clearly show the consistent hair, clothing layers, accessories and manuscript bundle.
